title: 51 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Perseverance)
description:
Learn 51 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 51 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Perseverance · 毅力
1:30  Making Plans · 制定计划
2:52  Mindfulness · 正念
4:13  Travel & Airport · 旅行与机场
5:29  Creativity · 创造力
6:46  Cultural Traditions · 文化传统
8:04  Daily Routine · 日常生活
9:24  Self Improvement · 自我提升

PHRASE LIST

PERSEVERANCE · 毅力
• When stuck, keep your pace - 卡住也别停，继续按节奏走  [Ka zhuo ye bie ting, ji xu an jie zou]
• Show up again, no drama - 再来一次也行，别想太多  [Zai lai yi ci ye xing, bie xiang tai duo]
• Your effort adds up quietly - 努力在慢慢累积，别怀疑  [Nu li zai man man lei ji, bie huai yi]
• One tough conversation, then breathe - 先把难聊的聊完，再喘口气  [Xian ba nan liao de liao wan, zai chuan kou qi]
• Keep going, even after backsliding - 退步了也没关系，马上把节拍找回来  [Tui bu le ye mei guan xi, ma shang ba jie pai zhao hui lai]
• Consistency beats mood every time - 靠坚持赢情绪，一样有效  [Kao jian chi ying qing xu, yi yang you xiao]

MAKING PLANS · 制定计划
• I’ll text you the schedule. - 我发你日程表吧。  [Wo Fā NI YìTéng BIǎo ba.]
• Let’s map out the week. - 我们把这周安排一下吧。  [WoMen Bǎ Zhè Zhōu ĀnPái YíXià ba.]
• What time do you want to start? - 你想几点开始？  [Ni Xiǎng Jǐ Diǎn KāiShǐ?]
• I’ll call after I check my calendar. - 我查完日历再给你打电话。  [Wo ChÁ Wán Rì Lì Zài Gěi Ni Dǎ DiànHuà.]
• First, we agree on the goal. - 先把目标说清楚。  [Xiān Bǎ MùBiāo Shuō QīngChu.]
• Can we set a realistic deadline? - 我们能定个比较现实的截止日期吗？  [WoMen Néng Dìng Gè BǐJiào XiànShí De JiéZhǐ RìQī ma?]
• I’ll break it into small steps. - 我把它拆成几个小步骤。  [Wo Bǎ Tā ChāiChéng Jǐ Gè Xiǎo BùZhòu.]

MINDFULNESS · 正念
• Notice your body’s signals right now - 觉察身体的信号，就在此刻。  [JUE CHA shen ti de xin hao, jiu zai ci ke.]
• Allow thoughts to pass, without chasing - 让念头过去，不去追。  [RANG nian tou guo qu, bu qu zhui.]
• Soften the jaw, ungrip your hands - 放松下巴，松开你的手。  [FANG SONG xia ba, SONG kai ni de shou.]
• Feel the air at your nostrils - 感受鼻尖的空气，进出之间。  [GAN SHOU bi jian de kong qi, jin chu zhi jian.]
• Count breaths softly, then stop counting - 轻轻数呼吸数到就好。  [QING QING shu hu xi shu dao jiu hao.]
• Notice your heartbeat, steady and kind - 觉察心跳，安稳而温柔。  [JUE CHA xin tiao, an wen er wen rou.]

TRAVEL & AIRPORT · 旅行与机场
• Where is the baggage claim? - 行李提取处在哪里？  [Xínglǐ tíqǔ chù zài nǎlǐ?]
• My flight gate changed, right? - 我的登机口是不是换了？  [Wǒ de dēngjī kǒu shì bú shì huàn le?]
• Do I need a visa? - 我需要签证吗？  [Wǒ xūyào qiānzhèng ma?]
• How do I get through security? - 安检怎么走？  [Ān jiǎn zěnme zǒu?]
• Is there a direct train? - 有没有直达火车？  [Yǒu méiyǒu zhídá huǒchē?]
• I need to change my ticket. - 我想改签机票。  [Wǒ xiǎng gǎi qiān jī piào.]
• My passport is in this bag. - 我的护照在这个包里。  [Wǒ de hùzhào zài zhège bāo lǐ.]

CREATIVITY · 创造力
• Turn questions into inventions. - 把问题变成发明吧。  [Bǎ Wèntí Biànchéng Fāmíng Ba.]
• Sketch ideas, even messy ones. - 先随手画下来，乱也没关系。  [Xiān Suíshǒu Huà Xiàlái, Luàn Yě Méi Guānxi.]
• Rewrite one sentence your way. - 换个角度改写一句话。  [Huàn Gè Jiǎodù Gǎixiě Yí Jù Huà.]
• Make a plan, then break it. - 先做计划，再大胆改掉它。  [Xiān Zuò Jìhuà, Zài Dàdǎn Gǎidiào Tā.]
• Steal, then make it yours. - 先学别人，再把它变成你的。  [Xiān Xué Biéren, Zài Bǎ Tā Biànchéng Nǐ De.]
• Swap mediums, same idea. - 把想法换个表现形式。  [Bǎ Xiǎngfǎ Huàn Gè Biǎoxiàn Xíngshì.]

CULTURAL TRADITIONS · 文化传统
• We eat mooncakes during Mid-Autumn - 中秋节我们吃月饼  [Zhōngqiū jié wǒmen chī yuèbǐng]
• Happy Dragon Boat Festival, eat zongzi - 端午节快乐，吃粽子吧  [Duānwǔ jié kuàilè, chī ZÒNGZI ba]
• Chinese New Year, we set off fireworks - 春节我们放烟花  [Chūn jié wǒmen fàng yān huā]
• We hang red couplets on the door - 我们把春联贴在门上  [Wǒmen bǎ chūnlián tiē zài mén shàng]
• At weddings, tea is served to elders - 结婚时要给长辈敬茶  [Jiéhūn shí yào gěi zhǎngbèi jìng chá]
• We bring fruit when visiting a home - 去别人家做客，带点水果很合适  [Qù biéren jiā zuòkè, dài diǎn shuǐguǒ hěn héshì]

DAILY ROUTINE · 日常生活
• I make coffee before work. - 我上班前先煮咖啡。  [Wo SHANG ban qian xian zhu KA fei]
• I check my phone right away. - 我一醒就先看手机。  [Wo yi XING jiu xian kan SHOU ji]
• I brush my teeth, twice. - 我刷牙两次。  [Wo SHUA ya liǎng ci]
• I take a shower after breakfast. - 我吃完早饭就洗澡。  [Wo chi wan zao fan jiu XI ZAO]
• I pack my lunch for tomorrow. - 我把明天的午饭准备好。  [Wo ba MING tian de wu FAN zhun bei hao]
• I leave home a little early. - 我会早点出门。  [Wo hui zao dian chu MEN]
• I commute by subway most days. - 我大多数日子坐地铁。  [Wo da duo shu ri zi zuo di TIE]

SELF IMPROVEMENT · 自我提升
• Upgrade your routine, not just your mind - 把你的习惯升级一下，而不只是想法  [bǎ nǐ de xíguàn SHENGJÍ yíxià, ér bù zhǐ shì xiǎngfǎ]
